label: <DEL> step of long (L>=8) sequences that start with z (weaker: start with o)
explanation: Fires almost only at the delimiter step (87% of mass), recall_idx 0, and only for long sequences (L=8: 25% of mass, L=9: 74%; never fires for L<=6). Magnitude depends strongly on the first original token: first token z gives the strongest activations (80% of mass; on <DEL> with L>=8 and first token z it fires 99% of the time), o is next (about 7%), and other first tokens give only weak, occasional firing at the L=9 delimiter. A smaller part (13% of mass) sits on the last one or two original tokens just before <DEL> in the same z-initial long sequences, usually as a weaker ramp into the delimiter peak. It never fires in the copy phase or in short sequences. The predicate has high precision but misses the many weak delimiter activations with other first tokens (dev recall 0.43, mass recall 0.72).

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the first original token (most: z, o, e, w, f, 1; least: a, d, u, v) and the next token to output (most: z, 0, w, m, b, o; least: x, y, v, -); timing cues that raise it most: t=8, L=9 & t=8, L=9 & t=9.
